result.title: Logit Averaging During Training Sets a New State of the Art for Non-Invasive Speech BCI
result.summary: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces are in practice limited by signal-to-noise ratio, and recent state-of-the-art methods address this limitation by aggregating over repeated trials of the same stimulus. Yet multi-trial aggregation has been treated inconsistently across the literature: some work averages brain signals at the model's input, other work averages predictions at the model's output, and neither treats aggregation as an architectural choice in its own right. We provide the first systematic comparison of aggregation strategies for non-invasive neural decoding, evaluating six paradigms (including logit averaging during training and three attention-based variants we introduce) across three datasets, four tasks, and two group sizes. We find that aggregation choice matters substantially: training-time logit averaging, the simplest method we propose, outperforms all others in 6 of 7 settings. On the phoneme classification setting of the 2025 PNPL competition, it sets a new state of the art, significantly outperforming the competition winner by 17.4 absolute percentage points in balanced accuracy. We further draw a theoretical connection between logit averaging and joint ensemble training, which has been shown to underperform independent ensembling in the deep learning literature; our results call into question recent explanations of why joint ensemble training fails. Together, these findings establish multi-trial aggregation as a key design choice for non-invasive neural decoding and identify training-time logit averaging as a simple, effective default.

AI.brief_summary: 系统比较非侵入式神经信号解码中的多试次聚合策略，提出训练期 logit 平均及三种注意力聚合变体，在三个数据集、四个任务上评测，并在 2025 PNPL 音素分类上超过竞赛冠军。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「输入端平均信号 vs 输出端平均预测」当作架构选择来对比、并给出 logit 平均与联合集成训练的理论联系，可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 轨迹或并行采样的证据聚合与训练监督提供可核查的迁移线索。
